data.gender_notes: Masira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Masira refers to a journey or voyage, symbolizing the spiritual journey towards Allah and the hereafter. It is derived from the Arabic root 's-r-r', meaning 'to move, to go, or to travel'. The name Masira carries the meaning “Journey, Voyage” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masira usually hope their child will grow to embody journey, voyage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
